title: Duty cycle compliance per region
description: Cross-validate duty cycle tracking for US/CA (100%), EU (1%), AU/NZ (5%). Test lichen_duty_cycle_can_transmit() and remaining_ms calculations.
close_reason: Invalid: The bead requests AU/NZ 5% duty cycle validation, but per spec (ccp4_regional_channel_plans.json), AU915 uses dwell_time mode (400ms max), not duty_cycle. Only EU868/CN470/IN865 use duty_cycle at 1%. Existing tests cover: C HAL tests (main.c:1310-1338) validate 10/100 permille; Python tests validate 1%/100% limits; ccp13.json provides authoritative vectors. US/CA/AU don't use duty cycle regulation.
